site.title: raqt fuel — London Catering
site.metaDescription: London's premium catering service. Any cuisine, any culture, any dietary request — cooked flawlessly for private dining, corporate events and brand activations.

hero.title:
We Cook
Anything You Crave
hero.subtitle: No menu. No limits. Tell us what you want — from any cuisine, any culture, any style — and we'll make it flawlessly. That's our promise.

philosophy.label: Our Philosophy
philosophy.title: Just Your Imagination.
philosophy.paragraph1: We don't believe in fixed menus. You dream it — we cook it. From Mexican tacos to Japanese kaiseki, from classic French to bold fusion — our chefs are masters across every cuisine and culture.
philosophy.paragraph2: Tell us what you're craving, and we'll source the finest ingredients, perfect the techniques, and present it with artistry. Any dish, any tradition, any dietary need — absolutely nothing is off the table.

cards.text: Thai, Italian, Lebanese, Mexican, Indian — our chefs are masters across every culinary culture. Nothing is beyond our reach.

cards.title:

Any Preference

cards.title:
From Street Food
to Fine Dining
cards.text: Craving authentic Bangkok street food? A 12-course tasting menu? Grandma's secret recipe? We are here to help you organise an event depending on your preferences.

items.text: We asked for an authentic Ethiopian feast with a modern twist — they delivered the most incredible meal we've ever had. These chefs can truly cook anything.
items.author: Catherine Whitmore

items.text: For our gala we wanted a fusion of Japanese and Peruvian cuisine. They didn't blink — just said 'tell us what you want' and created magic.
items.author: Harwood & Partners

items.text: My family is Lebanese and we wanted our wedding to reflect our heritage. raqt fuel made the most authentic tabbouleh and kibbeh I've had outside Beirut.
items.author: Nadia & Karim

items.text: Three of my team members have severe allergies. Not only did they accommodate everyone, but the food was so good nobody believed it was allergen-free.
items.author: Beaumont & Co.

cookie.text: This site uses cookies to improve your experience. By continuing, you agree to our use of cookies.

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
sections.body: When you use our website, we may collect personal information that you voluntarily provide to us when you fill out the enquiry form, including your name, email address, phone number, and event details. We also automatically collect certain technical information such as your IP address, browser type, and usage patterns through cookies and similar technologies.

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use the information we collect to respond to your catering enquiries, communicate with you about our services, improve our website and customer experience, and comply with legal obligations. We do not sell your personal information to third parties.

sections.heading: 3. Cookies
sections.body: Our website uses cookies to enhance your browsing experience, analyse site traffic, and remember your preferences. You can control cookie settings through your browser. Continuing to use our website signifies your consent to our use of cookies as described in this policy.

sections.heading: 4. Data Sharing
sections.body: We may share your information with trusted third-party service providers who assist us in operating our website and serving our customers (e.g., email delivery services, analytics providers). These parties are contractually obligated to protect your data and use it only for the purposes we specify.

sections.heading: 5. Data Security
sections.body: We implement reasonable security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorised access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. However, no method of transmission over the internet is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.heading: 6. Your Rights
sections.body: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information held by us. You may also object to or restrict certain processing of your data. To exercise these rights, please contact us using the details below.

sections.heading: 7. Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this Privacy & Terms policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.

sections.heading: 8. Contact Us
sections.body: If you have any questions about this Privacy & Terms policy or wish to exercise your data rights, please contact us at hello@raqtfuel.com or write to 67 Charlotte Street, London, W1T 4PD.
